definitions.native: the historical protocol: each method saves at floor(j*n_steps/19) of ITS OWN step count, compared index-by-index
definitions.aligned: every run uses n_steps = 19*q so all saved times are exactly j/19*T; the aligned ROM/DEIM use q >= their native step count (never coarser)
definitions.fom128_vs_fom1024: FOM Nx=128 vs FOM Nx=1024 at the shared 128 points (exact injection: x_j = x_{8j})
